symptoms: Latency climbing on POST /checkout and DB connection wait time is high. Error logs show 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms' on checkout-service-6c8f9.

actions.note: Latency got worse; the reconnect storm exhausted the pool again.
More replicas opened more DB connections and hit max_connections.
Pool size had been reduced from 50 to 10.

root_cause: Config deploy #4471 reduced the checkout-service DB connection pool size from 50 to 10.
resolution: Rolled back deploy #4471, restoring the pool size to 50.

alert: catalog-service read latency degraded, catalog-db CPU at 95%
symptoms: Product pages load slowly after overnight Redis maintenance. Cache hit ratio dropped sharply and the slow query log on catalog-db is spiking. Logs show 'redis: master changed, connection reset'.

actions.note: A cold cache made the stampede worse and DB CPU stayed pinned.

actions.action: Enabled request coalescing on hot product keys and warmed the cache gradually
actions.note: DB load dropped within ten minutes.

root_cause: A Redis failover emptied the catalog cache and a thundering herd of misses overloaded catalog-db.
resolution: Enabled request coalescing and warmed hot keys gradually while rate-limiting DB traffic.

alert: auth-service inbound TLS handshake failures spiking, login success rate 61%
symptoms: Clients fail mutual TLS to auth-service. Logs show 'x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid: current time 2026-03-09T00:31:12Z is after 2026-03-09T00:00:00Z'.

actions.note: No effect, the same expired cert was reloaded.

actions.action: Renewed the mTLS certificate from the internal CA and reloaded it
actions.note: Handshakes recovered immediately.

root_cause: The auth-service internal mTLS certificate expired and was not auto-renewed.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and reloaded it on the affected services.

symptoms: Writes are being rejected across ingest nodes. Logs show 'write failed: ENOSPC: No space left on device' and disk usage grew steadily over the past week.

actions.note: New pods landed on the same full nodes and were evicted.

actions.action: Purged old logs and fixed the logrotate config
actions.note: Volume dropped to 41% and stayed there.

root_cause: Unrotated log files filled the log-ingest volume.
resolution: Purged old logs and fixed the log rotation config.

alert: 502 rate from api-gateway to orders-api above 8% for 10m
symptoms: The gateway returns intermittent 502s while orders-api pods report healthy. orders-db logs show 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections'.

actions.note: Reconnect storm exhausted the pool again within two minutes.
The deploy had cut the pool size and idle timeout, causing connection churn.

root_cause: Config deploy #5102 lowered the orders-api pool size and idle timeout so connection slots ran out.

alert: cache miss ratio 0.94 on search-api, backend CPU saturated
symptoms: Search responses are slow and the index backend is saturated. Redis sentinel recorded a primary switch 9 minutes earlier and the log shows 'redis: master changed, connection reset'.

actions.note: A second cold start let the DB fall over again.

actions.action: Rate-limited DB traffic, enabled request coalescing and warmed hot keys
actions.note: Miss ratio recovered to 0.2 over 15 minutes.

root_cause: A Redis failover left search-api with an empty cache and misses overwhelmed the backend.
resolution: Rate-limited backend traffic and warmed hot keys gradually with coalescing on.

alert: notifications-service upstream calls to mail relay failing, 100% errors for 15m
symptoms: No emails or push messages are being sent. Logs show 'SSL handshake failed: tls: bad certificate' when connecting to the internal relay.

actions.note: No effect, the same expired cert was reloaded.

actions.action: Renewed the relay client certificate and reloaded it
actions.note: Queue drained within minutes.

root_cause: The notifications-service client certificate for the internal relay expired.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and reloaded it on notifications-service.

alert: inventory-service DB timeouts in stock-check path, error budget burn 14x
symptoms: Stock lookups time out and request threads are blocked. Logs show 'timeout acquiring connection from pool (inventory-service-7d9f, waited 30000ms)' starting right after the morning deploy.

actions.note: Extra replicas opened more DB connections and hit max_connections.
Pool size had been set to 8 by a template change.

root_cause: Config deploy #5688 shrank the inventory-service DB pool to 8 connections.

alert: user-profile-service origin load 6x baseline after Redis primary switchover
symptoms: Profile reads are slow and the database is under heavy load. Cache metrics show almost no hits since the switchover and the slow query log is full of profile lookups.

actions.note: Made the cold cache problem worse.
Second cold start, the DB fell over again.

actions.action: Enabled request coalescing and warmed hot profile keys gradually
actions.note: Load returned to normal after DB traffic was rate-limited.

root_cause: A Redis switchover emptied the profile cache and a stampede of misses hit the database.
resolution: Enabled request coalescing, rate-limited DB traffic and warmed hot keys gradually.

alert: billing-service invoice job failing, internal gRPC calls returning UNAVAILABLE
symptoms: Calls from billing-service to the ledger fail with UNAVAILABLE. Logs show 'x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid' for CN=ledger.internal.

actions.note: No effect, the expired cert was loaded again.

actions.action: Renewed the ledger certificate and reloaded it on the affected services
actions.note: Invoice job resumed on next retry.

root_cause: The internal mTLS certificate for ledger.internal expired and auto-renewal had not run.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and reloaded it on billing-service and ledger.

alert: reporting-service pods evicted repeatedly, node reports DiskPressure
symptoms: Pods restart in a loop and get evicted with 'The node had condition: [DiskPressure]'. Application logs before eviction show 'No space left on device'.

actions.note: New pods landed on the same full nodes and were evicted.

actions.action: Purged old logs and fixed the log rotation config
actions.note: Evictions stopped once the node had free space.

root_cause: Unrotated report-generation logs filled the node disk.
resolution: Purged old logs and fixed the log rotation config.

alert: analytics-worker jobs crashing on output write, node ephemeral storage exhausted
symptoms: Batch jobs abort mid-run with 'write failed: ENOSPC' and the node has ephemeral storage pressure. Log directory is 38 GB and growing.

actions.note: New pods landed on the same full nodes and were evicted.

actions.action: Purged old logs and fixed the log rotation config
actions.note: Jobs completed on the next run.

root_cause: Unrotated worker logs filled the volume on analytics nodes.
resolution: Purged old logs and fixed the log rotation config.

alert: payments-api authorization requests stalling, queue depth 3.2k and rising
symptoms: Card authorizations queue up while pod CPU stays low. Traces show requests idle waiting on the Postgres client, and logs show 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'.

actions.note: Queue grew faster after the restart because the pool was exhausted again.
The deploy had reduced the connection pool size.

root_cause: Config deploy #6240 reduced the payments-api DB connection pool size.

alert: cart-service errors climbing, Postgres replicas pegged at 100% CPU, cache hit rate collapsed
symptoms: Cart reads are slow and replicas are saturated. Redis sentinel logged a failover six minutes before the alert and cart-service logs show 'redis: master changed, connection reset'.

actions.note: Second cold start, the DB fell over again.

actions.action: Enabled request coalescing and warmed hot cart keys gradually while rate-limiting DB traffic
actions.note: Replica CPU fell below 40% in twelve minutes.

root_cause: A Redis failover emptied the cart cache and a thundering herd of misses overloaded the database.
resolution: Enabled request coalescing and warmed hot keys gradually with DB rate limiting.

alert: shipping-service label generation at 0% success, peers rejecting connections
symptoms: Peer services refuse connections from shipping-service during handshake. rate-service logs show 'remote error: tls: bad certificate' and cert-manager did not rotate the shipping-service certificate.

actions.note: No effect, the same expired cert was reloaded.

actions.action: Renewed the certificate and reloaded it on the affected services
actions.note: Labels started generating again.

root_cause: The shipping-service mTLS certificate expired because cert-manager rotation had stalled.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and reloaded it on the affected services.
